document.abstract: Every now and then, an innovator comes along and completely transforms the industry. Siegfried Foessel is one such innovator. In the world of imaging and video processing for broadcast and media production, Foessel is a leader with more than 80 publications and patents across 10 patent families. His work has had a global impact, and he is still working for a better future.
